source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, ive decided to initially upload the book to IPFS using Pinata, so that if the project flops or my story isn't received well, ill have the option to take it down.

But how does it work so that only NFT holders have access to it?
I was thinking 'Gate PDF with Lit Protocol; metadata links to gated viewer (auto-check ownership, no manual connect)'... but am happy to hear your suggestion for smoothest UX

also, you still need to adjust to view cover fully.

also, if my company registration gets rejected again (has been rejected 4 times, but should be approved today), are we able to proceed and launch crypto only and implement Transack in the coming days/weeks, once approved?

value_updates.hosted_content_withdrawal: The client must be able to take down the hosted ebook if necessary.
